expected_improvement: Six kangaroos should be easier to count because they will be arranged as six distinct, separated foreground figures with no extras.
The kangaroos-in-front-of-pigs relation should be clearer because the composition will use a strict front row for kangaroos and a back row for pigs.
The pigs should read as plastic because each pig will be explicitly described as a glossy plastic toy pig.
The pigs playing with the elephant should be clearer because the two pigs will face and touch/interact with the single checkered elephant.
preserve_constraints: Bind the checkered pattern to the single elephant.
Keep the elephant clearly checkered and visible.

previous_plan_error.details: The previous prompt stated the constraints but did not enforce a simple enough layout for counting six kangaroos or make the pigs' plastic material and play interaction visually explicit. The foreground/background relation may have been ambiguous because the pigs still needed to remain visible behind the kangaroos.
previous_plan_error.error_source: Prompt underspecified a countable layout, weak visual material cues for plastic pigs, and weak action cues for the pigs playing with the elephant.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Use a simple staged two-row composition: exactly six separated kangaroos in one front row across the lower foreground, with exactly two glossy plastic toy pigs behind them in the middle row, and exactly one checkered elephant behind/among the pigs. Make the two pigs face and touch/interact with the elephant so the play relation is visually readable, while keeping all objects unobstructed and countable.
regression_risks: The model may create fewer or more than six kangaroos.
The two pigs may lose the plastic toy appearance.
The pigs could be hidden by the kangaroos if the foreground row is too crowded.
The elephant's checkered pattern could be lost while focusing on the failed constraints.
Extra pigs, elephants, or kangaroos could appear in the background.
repair_constraints: Show exactly six kangaroos, no more and no fewer; make all six separate, fully visible, and individually countable.
Place all six kangaroos in the front foreground row, clearly closer to the viewer than the pigs.
Place exactly two pigs behind the kangaroos, still fully visible, so the kangaroos are unambiguously in front of the pigs.
Make each of the two pigs a glossy plastic toy pig; bind the plastic material only to the pigs.
Show the two plastic pigs playing with the single checkered elephant by facing the elephant and physically interacting with it.
Keep exactly one elephant and make that elephant clearly checkered.
Do not add any extra kangaroos, pigs, elephants, or duplicate animal figures.

retry_ready_action.regeneration_strategy: Use a simple staged two-row composition: exactly six separated kangaroos in one front row across the lower foreground, with exactly two glossy plastic toy pigs behind them in the middle row, and exactly one checkered elephant behind/among the pigs. regression_risks: The model may create fewer or more than six kangaroos.
The two pigs may lose the plastic toy appearance.

The elephant's checkered pattern could be lost while focusing on the failed constraints.
Extra pigs, elephants, or kangaroos could appear in the background.

Make each of the two pigs a glossy plastic toy pig; bind the plastic material only to the pigs.

Do not add any extra kangaroos, pigs, elephants, or duplicate animal figures.
